tasks.title: Add the clinical models and indexes to the Prisma schema
tasks.description: Add Patient, Doctor, Appointment and the AppointmentStatus enum to server/prisma/schema.prisma. Every table carries clinicId with a FK to Clinic; Appointment declares @@index([doctorId, startsAt]) and @@index([patientId]). The eight existing models are left untouched.

tasks.title: Generate the additive migration and read the emitted SQL
tasks.description: Run prisma migrate dev --name clinical_core, then read the generated migration.sql. Stop if it contains DROP or TRUNCATE, and confirm it does not touch the applied 20261028235000_init_tenancy migration.

tasks.title: Confirm the indexes and migration idempotency
tasks.description: Check that both indexes appear in the emitted SQL, and that a second prisma migrate deploy reports no pending migrations.

tasks.title: Extend the in-memory Prisma double
tasks.description: Add the three clinical collections and their query surface to server/src/database/memory-prisma.ts so the in-memory path the API tests use matches schema.prisma.

tasks.title: Seed the clinical dataset deterministically and idempotently
tasks.description: Extend server/src/database/seeds/seed.ts with an inline fixed-seed generator and upserts producing exactly 3 clinics, 10 doctors, 200 patients and 600 appointments, clinic-scoped and fictional. No new package is added.

tasks.title: Guard the seed against non-development databases
tasks.description: Read DATABASE_URL from the environment only and refuse to run when NODE_ENV=production. Restate the CON-506 local-fixtures-only warning in the file header.

tasks.title: Write the ERD
tasks.description: Create server/prisma/ERD.md with a Mermaid erDiagram covering Patient, Doctor and Appointment, their relations to Clinic and to each other, and the two indexes.

tasks.title: Record the migration and seed evidence
tasks.description: Run prisma migrate deploy twice and confirm the second reports no pending migrations; run the seed twice and confirm the counts stay 3/10/200/600. Record both results in the implementation report.

tasks.title: Run the verification gates
tasks.description: Run pnpm format:check on the changed files, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, sdrive verify database-schema-and-migrations, and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js.
